_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_kiery: The Commission

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Jack! You came to my shop! Most people just pass by.

options.text: I wanted to see your work.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Most people think sewing is small work. But every stitch is a choice.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I'll make you something special. Give me a week.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Thank you for seeing the craft. Not just the cloth.
